MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 57

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 17
   D. 11

3. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 20

4. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 13

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 25

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 73

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

14. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

15. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

16. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

18. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

19. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

20. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 10

21. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

22. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

23. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 13
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
